title: Gaislachkoglbahn Sölden
highlights: Modern cable car reaching 3,048 meters above sea level
Architectural masterpiece with futuristic station structures
Filming location of the James Bond production Spectre with 007 ELEMENTS
Comprehensive 360-degree panorama across more than 250 three-thousand-meter peaks
kurzbeschreibung: The futuristic Gaislachkoglbahn ascends to over 3,000 metres above sea level to the James Bond experience 007 ELEMENTS.
beschreibung:
Peak Architecture of Superlatives

The Gaislachkoglbahn in Sölden sets new standards for alpine cable car architecture. In two sections, guests glide from Sölden up to the 3,048-metre-high summit of the Gaislachkogel, where futuristic glass-and-steel stations blend harmoniously with the high-alpine rock landscape.

Cinematic World of James Bond

The Gaislachkogel gained worldwide fame as a spectacular filming location for the James Bond film Spectre. Right next to the top station and the gourmet restaurant ice Q, visitors immerse themselves in the secret agent's world at the subterranean cinematic installation 007 ELEMENTS. From the viewing platform, views extend over hundreds of snow-covered three-thousand-metre peaks across the Ötztal.
